headline: Databases and pipelines package taxonomy, annotation and alignment for reuse
label: Sequence Resources And Genomics Workflows
summary: New NAR database updates (NCBI, mOTUs-db, P2CS-Web) appear alongside workflow tools for nanopore 16S, genome alignment and annotation quality scoring.
synthesis: The dominant thread is making sequence-derived taxonomy, function and comparative genomics accessible through maintained resources and reproducible tooling. On the resource side, NCBI reviews updates to SRA, GenBank, RefSeq, the Submission Portal, NCBI Datasets and BLAST/annotation services. The mOTUs-db update links microbial taxonomy to genome-encoded function and environmental and geographic distributions, with a CLI and API for profiling. P2CS-Web connects prokaryotic two-component system repertoires to domain architectures, genomic neighbourhoods and sequence clusters. On the tooling side, VPHYL converts Emu and EPI2ME wf-16s nanopore 16S abundance tables into phyloseq or BIOM objects with HTML reports. nf-core/pairgenomealign wraps LAST pairwise whole-genome alignment in Nextflow with standard outputs and benchmarking. ABAQS scores genome annotation quality via completeness, gene model validity and protein profile accuracy, applied to over 1700 fungal genomes. Scopes differ, and the summaries do not support cross-tool comparisons.
